en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a cobblestone market square with a main street (Hauptstrasse) in a small European town. On the left are two‑ and three‑story buildings with shops including a cinema (Kino) and a house named Zur Ratswaage. On the right stands a large gabled building labeled Gasthaus zum Goldnen Löwen beside a tree‑lined open square. Several people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the street. At the top in red print is the caption identifying the town and location.
